scripts.setup: pnpm install && cd client && pnpm install && cd ../api && uv sync
scripts.dev: concurrently "cd api && uvicorn main:app --reload" "cd client && pnpm dev"
scripts.format:api: cd api && uv run ruff format .
scripts.format: pnpm run format:client && pnpm run format:api
scripts.format:check:api: cd api && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.format:check: pnpm run format:check:client && pnpm run format:check:api
scripts.lint:api: cd api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:client && pnpm run lint:api
scripts.lint:fix:api: cd api && uv run ruff check --fix .
scripts.lint:fix: pnpm run lint:fix:client && pnpm run lint:fix:api
